# 项目关键发现与经验 (2026-05-17)

## 1. 训练损伤根因确认 (D038)

**结论：contrastive joint training 对 action expert 造成 gradient pollution，是 v7 eval 回退的根因。**

Alpha sweep 证据：
| alpha | spatial SR | vs baseline(66.0%) |
|-------|-----------|-------------------|
| 0.0 (passthrough) | 58.2% | -7.8pp |
| 0.1 | 56.2% | -9.8pp |
| 1.0 seed1 | 58.4% | -7.6pp |
| 1.0 seed2 | 51.4% | -14.6pp |

关键洞察：alpha=0.0 和 alpha=1.0 seed1 几乎相同（58.2% vs 58.4%），说明 scoring 机制本身不造成额外损伤。回退完全来自训练过程中 contrastive loss 梯度传播到 action expert。

**解决方案：v7.1 scorer-only training（freeze_action_expert=True）**，仅训练 scorer（123K params），从原始 lerobot/smolvla_libero checkpoint 开始。

## 2. v7 Eval 完整结果

### Baseline (lerobot/smolvla_libero)
spatial=66.0%, object=67.8%, goal=76.4%, libero_10=54.2%, avg=66.1%

### v7 seed1 (alpha=1.0, full eval)
spatial=58.4%, object=58.6%, goal=72.8%, libero_10=39.4%, avg=57.3% (-8.8pp)

### v7 seed2 (alpha=1.0, full eval)
spatial=51.4%, object=49.4%, goal=63.0%, libero_10=42.2%, avg=51.5% (-14.6pp)

## 3. v7.1 Probe A 中间信号 (step 5000, seed1)

**Probe A FAIL**：cos ∈ [0.876, 0.973]，全部 > 0.8 阈值。
- inst 0 vs 1: 0.890
- inst 0 vs 2: 0.876
- inst 1 vs 2: 0.973

# 项目关键发现与经验 (2026-05-17)

## 1. 训练损伤根因确认 (D038)

**结论：contrastive joint training 对 action expert 造成 gradient pollution，是 v7 eval 回退的根因。**

Alpha sweep 证据：
| alpha | spatial SR | vs baseline(66.0%) |
|-------|-----------|-------------------|
| 0.0 (passthrough) | 58.2% | -7.8pp |
| 0.1 | 56.2% | -9.8pp |
| 1.0 seed1 | 58.4% | -7.6pp |
| 1.0 seed2 | 51.4% | -14.6pp |

关键洞察：alpha=0.0 和 alpha=1.0 seed1 几乎相同（58.2% vs 58.4%），说明 scoring 机制本身不造成额外损伤。回退完全来自训练过程中 contrastive loss 梯度传播到 action expert。

## 2. v7 Eval 完整结果

### Baseline (lerobot/smolvla_libero)
spatial=66.0%, object=67.8%, goal=76.4%, libero_10=54.2%, avg=66.1%

### v7 seed1 (alpha=1.0, full eval)
spatial=58.4%, object=58.6%, goal=72.8%, libero_10=39.4%, avg=57.3% (-8.8pp)

### v7 seed2 (alpha=1.0, full eval)
spatial=51.4%, object=49.4%, goal=63.0%, libero_10=42.2%, avg=51.5% (-14.6pp)

## 3. v7.1 → v7.2 演进

### v7.1 scorer-only (FAIL, D041)
- 仅训练 scorer (123K params)，冻结全部 base_policy (450M)
- Probe A step 5000: cos [0.876, 0.973] — 全部 > 0.8
- Probe A step 20000: seed1 min cos=0.852 FAIL; seed2 cos=0.492 但为 global bias（mean-level shift, 非 spatial conditioning）
- **结论**：冻结 feature 上 scorer 的 capacity 不足以学习 language-conditioned spatial importance

### v7.2 connector+scorer (极强正面信号)
- 解冻 connector (11.8M) + scorer (0.1M) = 11.9M trainable, 冻结其余 436.5M
- 关键修复：contrastive path 不 detach visual tokens（让梯度流过 connector）+ drift regularization (λ=0.1)
- **Probe A step 15000**:
  - Seed 1: cos [0.804, 0.885, 0.948], weight_std 全部 > 0.19
  - Seed 2: cos [0.601, 0.697, 0.923], weight_std 全部 > 0.19
- **vs v7.1**: connector 解冻后 cos 从 0.85+ 降到 0.60，weight_std 从未报告到全部 > 0.19
- **判定**：true spatial conditioning (不是 global bias)，v7.2 路线有效

## 4. SmolVLA 模型结构关键信息

| 组件 | prefix | 参数量 |
|------|--------|--------|
| Vision Encoder | `vlm_with_expert.vlm.model.vision_model` | 86.4M |
| Connector (PixelShuffle) | `vlm_with_expert.vlm.model.connector` | 11.8M |
| VLM Text Model | `vlm_with_expert.vlm.model.text_model` | 204.6M |
| VLM LM Head | `vlm_with_expert.vlm.lm_head` | 47.3M |
| LM Expert (action head) | `vlm_with_expert.lm_expert` | 98.2M |
| Total | — | 450M |

freeze_mode 选项：legacy / scorer_only / connector_scorer / all_trainable

## 5. 磁盘状态（2026-05-16）
- /root/autodl-tmp: 250G total, 84G used, 167G free (34%)

## 6. 代码就绪状态
- scorer-only: `--train_scorer_only --freeze_action_expert`
- connector+scorer: `--freeze_mode connector_scorer --lambda_drift 0.1`
- eval 脚本: run_v71_eval_alpha00.sh, run_v71_eval_alpha10.sh (可复用于 v7.2)
- perturbation eval: run_v71_perturbation_eval.sh
- probe: run_v71_probe_a.sh

## 7. 经验教训
- `--conditioning_mode concat` 参数不是所有脚本都支持——eval_acib.py 不识别此参数导致 submit_training_job 静默失败
- Cron EXIT_CODE=129 常为 wrapper PID 误报（实际训练进程正常完成）——on_failed 回调必须先 SSH 验证
